scenario.name: set_a chains shorter than the training-fold median length
scenario.threshold_source: median of n_res_per on the pinned training wide cache
scenario.why_this_cut: one training-side constant, applied after an exploratory length split pointed at short chains

search_that_preceded_the_cut: positive-count thirds, length thirds, and the previously published under-10 / 10-to-22 / over-22 cryptic-count bands, on Set A and on B+C. The only counting-field interval excluding zero from above was the short third of Set A. Two B+C middle bands excluded zero from below, toward logistic.
